$comment: Optional QRSPI local config. Copy to .qrspi/config.json (gitignored) to use it. REVIEWERS: by default — with no config file — the qrspi-batch finalizer requests review from '@me' (the gh-authenticated user running the harness), so a fresh clone needs zero setup and ships no hard-coded username. 'reviewers' are GitHub logins (the literal '@me' expands to the authenticated user; set [] to request no reviewer); 'teamReviewers' are Graphite/GitHub team slugs ('org/team' or 'team'). LINEAR: 'linearTeam' is the Linear team /qrspi-ticket files new issues under (if unset, the skill discovers/asks); 'linearProject' is the Linear project, defaulting to 'QRSPI' — it scopes BOTH ticket creation (/qrspi-ticket files new issues under it) AND batch runs (qrspi-batch sweeps only this project's assigned tickets by default; pass {"project":"..."} to override for one run, or {"allProjects":true} to sweep every project).
